title: Discipline beats motivation: three small habits that make it stick

hook.text: Motivation fades by Wednesday. So what gets you to the gym, the desk, or the hard conversation on a bad day?

introduction.topicIntro: Here are three small habits that turn effort into something you can repeat.
introduction.valueProposition: Each one takes less than ten minutes, and none of them runs on willpower.

sections.title: Decide once
content: Pick the time and the place the night before, so the morning has no decision left in it.
A choice you already made costs nothing to keep.

sections.title: Make it small
content: Start with a version so small it feels silly, like two minutes of reading.
Small wins on bad days protect the habit until the good days come back.

sections.title: Track the streak
content: Mark each day you show up, on paper you can see.
A visible streak gives you a reason to keep going that does not depend on your mood.

conclusion.title: Takeaways
conclusion.finalThought: Motivation is the spark. Discipline is the wiring that keeps the lights on.

callToAction.subscribe: Subscribe for one practical habit for mind and body every week.
callToAction.comment: Which of the three will you start tonight?
